# Selected private application work

These projects are represented through public engineering summaries. Private implementation, business records and user data remain private.

## Vendiqo

Offline Windows retail workflows: purchasing, inventory, sales, credit/collections, referenced returns, reservations, supplier payments and reporting. Transactional services and a movement ledger keep state consistent; guarded recovery and Windows packaging support delivery. Release candidate; code signing and final hardware acceptance remain release tasks.

[Read the case study](case-studies.html#vendiqo).

## Cineyra

Film/TV discovery with persistent taste, temporary viewing context, deterministic ranking and optional AI reasoning. Work includes account isolation, transactional preference reconciliation, export and deletion, with live QA and synthetic browser regression coverage. Private MVP.

[Read the case study](case-studies.html#cineyra).

## Qashoryx

Independent client software delivered for a shop in Ranipur, maintained since June 2026. Requirements, implementation and ongoing support cover invoices, inventory, payments, customer accounts and recovery. No customer records or operational dataset counts are published here.

[Read the project story](case-studies.html#qashoryx).

## Additional work

[Spenvera](case-studies.html#spenvera) explores local budgeting, linked payments and backup validation. [Fixloom](case-studies.html#fixloom) connects repair intake, history, payments and job documents. [Nourentra](case-studies.html#nourentra) remains an early workflow prototype using fictional data.

Summaries reviewed 29 October 2026. Product status is distinct from source availability; private projects are not offered as public downloads.
